newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Fed is expected to inject reserves into the banking system via a round of overnight system repurchase agreements Friday, analysts said.
Thursday, the Fed added through overnight system RPs, which totaled $7.649 billion. Analysts said the operation was larger than they had anticipated.

Still, they pointed out, the Fed faces around an $11 billion a day add need in the maintenance period which began Thursday. This should force the Fed back in the open market this session -- even as 13-day system RPs and seven-day system RPs remain outstanding.
Fed funds were trading at the 5-1/4 percent target rate.
